fr_html: Le PRESIDENT croit que M. de Lapradelle méconnaît l'influence des considérations politiques qui entreront en jeu, si le choix est confié aux gouvernements.
en_html: The PRESIDENT thought that M. de Lapradelle underestimated the effect of the political considerations which would come into play if governments were called upon to make the selections.
